title: UI clone report
description: What happened to each component of one site's shadcn registry when ui-clone collected it into victor-ui, in the registry's order.

site.description: The sites.json key, or the URL's host when the site has no entry.

into.description: Absolute path of the victor-ui repo.

dryRun.description: True when nothing was written. Outcomes are still decided, so kept means it would be kept.

outcome.description: kept: code written into victor-ui. locked: the site does not expose the code, as empty files or HTTP 401. skipped: a registry type other than registry:ui or registry:block. needs-terms: no written terms allow keeping code from this site. failed: any other error.

detail.description: What add.mjs printed, why it is locked or skipped, or the error code and message.
